deadline.value: January 7 for full consideration (September start); rolling review so apply early. Year inferred.
deadline.quote: January 7th Applications received by this day will receive full consideration for admission to the MSc/MASc/PhD program in the following academic year (September start).

app_fee.value: Amount not shown on the pages checked

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the pages checked

gre_general.value: Not required; good scores may strengthen an application
gre_general.quote: Do I need to take the GRE general and subject exams? We do not require you to take these, however a good performance in the exams may strengthen your application.

gre_physics.value: Not required; good scores may help
gre_physics.quote: We do not require you to take these, however a good performance in the exams may strengthen your application.

toefl_min.value: ELP test required for non-native speakers; minimum not shown on the pages checked
toefl_min.quote: Those applicants whose native languages do not include English will need to earn satisfactory standing in an English Language Proficiency Test

english_waiver.value: You may REQUEST an exemption if, in the 12 months before applying, you studied 1+ full year at a post-secondary institution where English is the official language of instruction
english_waiver.quote: Any applicant whose first language is not English, but who, within the 12 month period prior to the month of application, has studied for at least one complete year at a post-secondary institution where English is the official language of instruction, may submit with their application a request to be exempted

supervisor.value: A complete application needs a research proposal; work with a potential supervisor early
supervisor.quote: A complete application requires reference letters and a research proposal, so working with your potential supervisor and an early start is recommended.

funding.value: Minimum stipend guaranteed; PhD for four years (TA ~10 h/week in fall/winter contributes)
funding.quote: If you are accepted into Graduate studies in our department then we guarantee at least the minimum stipends found on the Funding sections under the MSc, MASc and PhD degree overview pages.

entry_route.value: PhD normally needs an MSc/MASc; exceptional master's students may move up without finishing
entry_route.quote: The minimum qualification for admission to the doctoral program is a Master's Degree in Science or Applied Science.

notes: Research proposal required. OGS applications due March 1.
